correctness.rationale: The complete seven-blob source tree and all seven files were inspected at frozen commit. König’s α=|S|−matching-number identity bounds faces by dimension 3, with triangles indexed by edges in triples and tetrahedra by two disjoint edges. An equivariant surjection from E⊗V onto triangles has adjacent-edge-pair kernel A after removing endpoint summands E⊕U. Sym²E=U⊕A⊕D, and the disjoint matching-to-tetrahedron map has unsigned four-cycle permutation kernel because two matchings in an induced C4 differ by the sum of oriented matchings. Eliminating these in the reduced chain Euler class and using 0→B→E→V→Q→0 gives Q[C4]−Sym²B. Trace(g|Sym²B)=(τ(g)^2+τ(g²))/2 and connected graph signed-edge trace justify the Lefschetz identity. Finite group invariants justify rational quotient Euler. Independently rebuilt direct-face signed Lefschetz checks found agreement on 230 connected bipartite graphs with 786 symmetries and all 48 cube automorphisms; these finite tests only corroborate, not prove, the all-graph theorem. One-vertex/one-edge boundary consistent.

value.rationale: A universal automorphism-equivariant rational Euler identity is a motivated exact invariant for independence-bounded/robust clique complexes of every finite connected bipartite graph, and expresses all signed Lefschetz traces and rational quotient Euler numbers from natural H1 cycle representations and four-cycle permutations.
